tour.title: Tutorial
tour.autoAdvance: Carries on by itself once this is done

hint.title: Come back any time
hint.body: The tutorial lives up here. Every section can be opened on its own.

welcome.title: A quick tour?
welcome.body: Six short sections: what to install, where your media lives, and how to play it. You can leave at any point.

offer.title: A quick look at this page?

tourButton.title: The tutorial lives here
tourButton.body: Press this to see it again later. Every section can be opened on its own.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Everything needed before the first run is on this page.

ytdlp.title: Install yt-dlp
ytdlp.body: It does the downloading from video sites. Press Install and wait for the dot to turn green.

ffmpeg.title: Install ffmpeg
ffmpeg.body: Needed to join video and audio, and to make thumbnails.

session.title: Sign in to EroScripts
session.body: Needed to read posts and fetch their attachments. This can wait until later.

libraries.title: Tags and libraries
libraries.body: Media lives in libraries. The first one is added here.

addLibrary.title: Add a library
addLibrary.body: Pick the folder your videos are in. Funscripts and subtitles beside them are picked up with them.

scan.title: Scanning
scan.body: The folder is read now and watched from here on. New files turn up on the media page by themselves.

sources.title: Video players
sources.body: Who shows the picture. The built-in player works as it is.

sourceList.title: Pick the current player
sourceList.body: One at a time. Press a row to switch to it.

addSource.title: Add a player
addSource.body: mpv, MPC-HC or HereSphere, if you would rather use your own.

scriptPlayer.title: Script player
scriptPlayer.body: This is what drives your device from the funscript.

route.title: Who drives the device
route.body: The built-in engine, or MultiFunPlayer. Only one of them holds the port.

addOutput.title: Add an output
addOutput.body: Choose how the device is reached: Buttplug, a serial port, or The Handy.

connect.title: Connect
connect.body: Fill in the port or address, then press Connect. The dot on the tab turns green once the device answers.

play.title: Play something
play.body: Double-click a video. The script follows it, and the bar along the bottom keeps the controls.

sidebar.title: Filters
sidebar.body: Tags, performers, studios and folders. A pick narrows the list on the right.

search.title: Search
search.body: Searches the whole library by name.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.body: Favourites, wanted, and files with no script yet.

view.title: Grid or list
view.body: The list shows paths and script counts; the grid shows artwork.

playlists.title: Playlists and queue
playlists.body: Build the queue here; it keeps playing as you move between pages.

sync.title: Rescan
sync.body: Picks up files added or moved outside the app.

detail.title: One video
detail.body: Double-click to play; the details open its tags, scripts and artwork for editing.

kinds.title: Tags, performers, studios, collections
kinds.body: One list per kind. Pick the one you are editing.

new.title: Create
new.body: What you create here can then be put on any media.

list.title: The list
list.body: Drag one onto another to nest it. Select one to rename it, give it aliases, or merge it away.

clean.title: Clean up
clean.body: Removes entries nothing uses any more.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.body: Library roots are added and removed on this side.

library.title: Where it lands
library.body: The library downloaded files are filed into.

parse.title: Parse
parse.body: Reads the posts and lists what can be downloaded from them.

pick.title: Pick what to download
pick.body: Tick the video and the scripts you want; the post's tags and link are saved with them.

queue.title: The queue
queue.body: Downloads run here. They carry on while you use the rest of the app.

start.title: Start a scan
start.body: Looks for the forum post each file in your libraries came from.

review.title: Confirm the matches
review.body: Certain ones are applied on their own; the rest wait here for you to pick or skip.

open.both: The player and the script player are open in windows of their own.
open.video: The player is open in a window of its own.
open.script: The script player is open in a window of its own.

updates.title: Updates
updates.readyHint: Restart to install it now, or it installs when you quit.
updates.notSupported: To update from here, install the app from a GitHub release.
updates.confirmOlder: Go back to version {{version}}? Anything saved by newer versions may not open in it.
